name: video-pip
note: Rounds 9-16 (operator UAT 2026-08-10/13, 2026-09-02). ROUND 16 IS THE GOVERNING LAW (verbatim: "don't auto hide yt video. I keep having to open it to skip after ads"): THE APP NEVER HIDES THE VIDEO ON ITS OWN. A fresh open shows the video (theater) so YouTube's Skip Ads is reachable with no tap; there is no auto-minimize timer and no countdown at all. Round 15's intent ("not show the video any other time") survives as a REMEMBERED CHOICE - park it once and every later open is parked (music.vidPref.v1, additive), until you show it again. Why the reversal: twice an automatic hide trapped the operator inside an ad - a 7s wall-clock collapse (2026-07-31, mitigated to a 15s playback-anchored window), then round 15's open-PARKED default, which silently undid that mitigation. The ad boundary is undetectable cross-origin, so no timer can be tuned safely around it. Unchanged from rounds 9-15: the bar's LEFT zone toggles parked<->THEATER one tap each way (theater is where taps reach the embed - Skip lives there); the theater's bottom handle DISMISSES to parked with no intermediate docked step; the small docked PIP is OPT-IN via the theater strip's corner dock chip only. ONE element, the iframe never remounts (audio never dies). Plus: continuous playerState sync (the field rides every infoDelivery tick - pausing inside the embed must flip the bar within a second, missed onStateChange deltas notwithstanding), scrub with touch-action:none (without it the browser reclaims the touch for panning and kills the drag a few px in), and refocus honesty. Native requestPictureInPicture is unreachable for a cross-origin YT iframe - overlays by design.

steps.label: ROUND 16 - ROW-TAP PLAY on a FRESH device opens the video VISIBLE (theater): no stored preference, so the ad's Skip button is on screen without a tap. Supersedes round 15's always-PARKED open, which is what put every pre-roll behind a manual open.

PARK (theater down-arrow) -> the quiet state round 15 asked for is still one tap away: media zero-size but the SAME iframe mounted (audio alive), player wears .vidhid, the title wears the cue, and NO video chrome is visible (no PIP, no handles)
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('hid'))return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width<2&&r.height<2))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(!f)return false;if(f!==window.__pipFrame)return false;var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidhid')||p.classList.contains('vidopen'))return false;var cue=getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.bt-st-t'),'::before').content;if(!cue||cue==='none')return false;var hidden=['[data-piphide]','[data-thmax]','[data-thmin]','[data-thdock]'].every(function(s){var e=document.querySelector(s);return !e||e.getBoundingClientRect().height===0;});return hidden;})()

steps.label: LEFT-ZONE tap -> THEATER directly (the skip surface), floating over the library with the player STILL mini: fixed centered card, NO click-catcher (Skip is tappable here), same iframe, the park handle (bottom bar) AND the opt-in dock chip (strip corner) both on
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidopen')||!p.classList.contains('mini'))return false;var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||m.classList.contains('min')||m.classList.contains('hid'))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m).position!=='fixed')return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(Math.abs(r.width-392)<3&&r.top>40&&r.top<120))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m,'::after').content!=='none')return false;if(m.querySelector('iframe')!==window.__pipFrame)return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-thmin]');if(!h||h.getBoundingClientRect().height<20)return false;var dk=document.querySelector('[data-thdock]');if(!dk)return false;var dr=dk.getBoundingClientRect();return dr.height>20&&Math.abs(dr.right-r.right)<3;})()

steps.label: the theater's down-arrow DISMISSES to PARKED - no intermediate docked step (round 15 operator ask, verbatim), audio-alive iframe untouched, cue back on the title
OPT-IN dock: the strip's corner chip is the only way into the small PIP - docked above the bar, maximize bar on top, park tab flush on its left, same iframe
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('min'))return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>130&&r.width<170&&r.height>90&&r.height<120))return false;var bar=document.querySelector('.bt-st-head').getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.bottom<=bar.top+2))return false;var tx=document.querySelector('[data-thmax]');if(!tx||tx.getBoundingClientRect().height<14)return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-piphide]');if(!h)return false;var hr=h.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(hr.right<=r.left&&r.left-hr.right<3))return false;return m.querySelector('iframe')===window.__pipFrame;})()

steps.label: the PIP's top bar maximizes back to theater (still no Studio switch)
the PIP's flush left tab parks it - same end state as every other dismiss
SCRUB (parked, in mini): the track owns its touches (touch-action none - the browser must never reclaim the drag for panning); synthesized duration, pointer-drag to ~60%, fill lands at 60

PLAYERSTATE SYNC: pausing inside the embed must flip the bar - a synthesized infoDelivery tick carrying playerState 2 flips to Play + npPaused, and playerState 1 flips back (the field rides every tick, so missed delta events cannot leave the bar lying)
REFOCUS HONESTY: a visibility return while marked playing flips the bar to PAUSED - backgrounding always pauses the embed, the bar must never lie
the STUDIO DOOR (playing row's details chip) opens idempotently - same iframe, video STILL parked (the quiet default holds through navigation), menu offers Show video
the left-zone toggle works in the open Studio too - theater floats over the sheet, menu flips to Hide video
back to the library: the video stays PARKED through the whole trip (the quiet default is the resting state), iframe alive the entire time
